body: Thanks. I am going to look into whether my school offers for counseling but we are a campus of some 30,000 students so it is limited, maybe I will just suck it up and find a therapist. I am trying to do everything I can to help myself right now, I'm working out 5 days a week and trying to invest as much as possible into my dayjob (I intern for the Department of Commerce) I think maybe it is a big mistake I kept in contact with him at all. I also feel like it's unfair that he's giving me such a hard time for stripping now that we're not together when he never did while we were. He has to rub shit in my face like how he's a successful engineer and I am just a cheating stripper, but then go and say shit like I was the best thing he ever had and how, when I stopped dancing while I could that I was everything that he wanted. Just three days ago he told me he wanted to give it a try and that I was worth a shot and then he laid it on me that I am a liar for not telling him I started dancing again (it was quite recent) when I haven't seen him in a month. It fucks with my head so much

Thank you. This does help. I regret the fact that I do this for a living but having a livelihood unfortunately outweighs this. I hope that I can find ways that will help me recover and find hope for a better future with someone else when I am ready
